title: Stage artifact front matter (design §5)
description: Canonical contract for the YAML front matter of .agent/work/<id>/<stage>.md. There is deliberately no status/verdict field: only verify-candidate emits results. The gauntlet engine in scripts/verify-candidate is the validator; parity is scenario-bound (§11, §13).

gitHead.description: Diagnostic metadata only; never evidence identity.

author.description: Worker that produced the artifact (design §5, §8.5). Optional in the schema so pre-revision artifacts stay parseable; verification requires a non-empty value on every due artifact of a non-grandfathered item, and qa's author must differ from coder's.
